row.notes: Shared onUpdate tail of the in-race session states (InGame vtable slot ptr 0x1457e6cd8; tail-called by FormationLap 0x142d5d8cb, InGamePQ 0x142d683b6, 0x142d56660, 0x142e055e2, 0x142e09761). Returns g_Game_FlowLinkStay while st+0xee9. Online: when the host signals session end ([st+0xcb0]+0x180 == 0, +0xf8) sets st+0xee2 and hands every car to controller type 3 (0x14389cc90(st+0xd90, i, 1, 3)); else decides st+0xee1 (player finished: car record +0x18 state 7/5/3 with distance thresholds 6 m / 8 m). Practice/qualifying (Sess_Rules_IsPracticeQualifying): tracks the player's pit status (+0xee4, mask 0x1e01) and toggles the garage UI (0x1445d5c40). Route results: 0x192e0a32 (UI exit), 0xfa1db361 (st+0xee0 quit), 0x3d9a48de (st+0xee1 player finished), 0x5fa57fc (st+0xee3), 0x38d5604f (st+0xee2 session complete, after the countdown st+0xe6c and the results camera), otherwise ticks director [st+0xe90] and FUN_142d61d70 and stays. (used by vmknolle race-start)
